display_title: Eureka-cluster Xecs voor micro- en nano-elektronica – Eureka-cluster Xecs
call_title: Eureka-cluster Xecs voor micro- en nano-elektronica
executive_summary: National co-funding by RVO for Dutch partners in international Xecs projects (an Eureka cluster for market-oriented R&D on electronic components and systems), with partners from at least two countries and at least 35 person-years of effort. The Dutch budget is EUR 10 million a year, with at most EUR 4 million per Dutch consortium and rates of 25% to 50% depending on organisation type and research or development work. The international Project Outline is due on 21 January 2027 and the Full Project Proposal, by invitation, on 15 April 2027; the national application is expected in April 2027.
status_rationale: The RVO Xecs page (Voor wie?, Voorwaarden) and RNES title 3.8 fund market-oriented R&D on electronic components and systems in any application area, which allows energy-system electronics such as the sensors and operational technology behind Reliability Centered Maintenance (RCM) and SylWin1 HVDC retrofit; the link to TenneT depends on the consortium's chosen application. Consortia may include user organisations, and RNES article 3.8.2 funds each participant in an Xecs-labelled consortium at 35% (industrial research) or 25% (experimental development) for a large company, so TenneT TSO B.V. could be a funded partner (C1.3). Article 3.8.9 excludes applications from government bodies, which on our reading does not cover TenneT TSO B.V. as a private-law company.
